## createFormat() function

Creates a set of pre-configured formatters for various numeric formats.

The `createFormat` function generates formatters for hex, number, commas-separated, short, and percentage formats. It allows setting default options for all formatters and defining custom formatters for specific use cases.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function createFormat<TCustom extends Record<string, FormatNumberOptions | FormatShortOptions | FormatPercentOptions | FormatCommasOptions | FormatHexOptions> & {
    [K in keyof TDefaultOptions]?: never;
} = {}>(defaultOptions?: Partial<TDefaultOptions>, customFormatters?: TCustom): {
    readonly hex: HexFormatter;
    readonly number: NumberFormatter;
    readonly commas: CommasFormatter;
    readonly short: ShortFormatter;
    readonly percent: PercentFormatter;
} & { readonly [K in keyof TCustom]: TFormatters[TCustom[K]["format"]]; };
```

{ readonly hex: [HexFormatter](./morpho-ts.hexformatter.md)<!-- -->; readonly number: [NumberFormatter](./morpho-ts.numberformatter.md)<!-- -->; readonly commas: [CommasFormatter](./morpho-ts.commasformatter.md)<!-- -->; readonly short: [ShortFormatter](./morpho-ts.shortformatter.md)<!-- -->; readonly percent: [PercentFormatter](./morpho-ts.percentformatter.md)<!-- -->; } &amp; { readonly \[K in keyof TCustom\]: TFormatters\[TCustom\[K\]\["format"\]\]; }

An object containing pre-configured formatters and custom formatters if provided.

## Example 1

// Create default formatters const format = createFormat(); console.log(format.number.of(1234.56)); // Output: "1234.56" console.log(format.commas.of(1234.56)); // Output: "1,234.56"

## Example 2

// Create formatters with default options const format = createFormat(<!-- -->{ all: { digits: 2 }<!-- -->, number: { unit: "$" }<!-- -->, }<!-- -->); console.log(format.number.of(1234.56)); // Output: "$1234.56" console.log(format.short.of(1234567.89)); // Output: "1.23M"

## Example 3

// Adding custom formatters const format = createFormat(<!-- -->{<!-- -->}<!-- -->, { customHex: { format: Format.hex, prefix: true } }<!-- -->); console.log(format.customHex.of(255)); // Output: "0xff"
